definitions.explanation: A written or spoken representation of something; the act of describing or writing about something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧{記述|きじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{記述|きじゅつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よる→よる：02440_yoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧。
{記述|きじゅつ}⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。

notes:
{記述|きじゅつ} refers to the act of writing something down in a descriptive or explanatory way, or the resulting written description. It has a formal, academic tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}する→記述する：17347_kijutsusuru⟧: to describe, to write down
- {記述|きじゅつ}⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧: essay-type, descriptive (as in exam questions requiring written answers, as opposed to ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧ multiple choice)
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{記述|きじゅつ}: detailed description
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{記述|きじゅつ}: historical account
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{記述|きじゅつ}: accurate description

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧: writing/listing (more formal, used for official records and documents)
- ⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧: depiction (visual or literary, emphasizes vividness)
- ⟦{叙述|じょじゅつ}→叙述：noentry⟧: narration (telling a story or sequence of events)
- ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: explanation (focuses on making something understood)

{記述|きじゅつ} emphasizes the written record or account itself, while ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ focuses more on helping the listener/reader understand.
